labels.shortDescription: Gift Transaction mirror: one gift not copied
labels.value: The Gift Transaction mirror could not copy the gift {0}: {1}

labels.shortDescription: Gift Transaction mirror: several gifts not copied
labels.value: The Gift Transaction mirror could not copy {0} gifts ({1}): {2}

labels.shortDescription: Gift Transaction mirror: gift has no account donor
labels.value: The gift has no Donor Account and no Household, and a Gift Transaction's donor must be an account. Give the donor a household, and the next run copies the gift.

labels.shortDescription: Gift Transaction mirror: linked Gift Transaction gone
labels.value: The Gift Transaction linked to the gift was deleted or is not visible to you. If it was deleted, clear the gift's Gift Transaction ID to have a new one made; if it still exists, give the person running the mirror access to it.

labels.shortDescription: Gift Transaction mirror: Gift Transaction ID format
labels.value: Gift Transaction ID must be the record ID of a Nonprofit Cloud Gift Transaction (15 or 18 characters), or empty.

labels.shortDescription: Gift Transaction mirror: created record left unlinked
labels.value: The Gift Transaction mirror created the Gift Transaction {0} for this gift, could not store its Gift Transaction ID on the gift, and could not delete the Gift Transaction again: {1} Delete that Gift Transaction, or paste its ID onto the gift once the gift can be saved.

labels.shortDescription: Gift Transaction mirror: designation not created
labels.value: The Gift Transaction was created, but a designation could not be: {0}

labels.shortDescription: Gift Transaction mirror: deleted gift keeps its record
labels.value: Its Gift Transaction is left in place. Delete it in Nonprofit Cloud yourself if it should go.

labels.shortDescription: Gift Transaction mirror: one linked gift deleted
labels.value: The gift {0}, linked to a Gift Transaction, was deleted. {1}

labels.shortDescription: Gift Transaction mirror: several linked gifts deleted
labels.value: {0} gifts linked to Gift Transactions were deleted ({1}). {2}

labels.shortDescription: Gift Transaction mirror: paid status not active
labels.value: The Gift Transaction mirror paid status, {0}, is not one of the active Status values of Gift Transactions in this org, so nothing is copied. Copy the value exactly, as its API name, from the Status field in Setup.

labels.shortDescription: Gift Transaction mirror: no start date
labels.value: Nothing is copied until you set Gift Transaction mirror start date in BarnCRM Settings, Giving. Only gifts dated on or after it are copied.

labels.shortDescription: Gift Transaction mirror: no Gift Transactions here
labels.value: This org has no Nonprofit Cloud Gift Transactions you can use, so there is nothing to mirror. The Gift Transaction mirror needs Nonprofit Cloud fundraising and, for you, the Fundraising User permission. It is also unavailable when this org's Gift Transaction fields differ from what this version of BarnCRM expects.

labels.shortDescription: Gift Transaction mirror: runner lacks access
labels.value: You cannot create, edit or read Gift Transactions as the mirror needs, or you do not have the Gift Transaction Mirror permission set, so a run started by you would copy nothing.

labels.shortDescription: Gift Transaction mirror: run skipped while paused
labels.value: The Gift Transaction mirror run did nothing, because automation is paused on the Automation page. The next run after it resumes catches up.

labels.shortDescription: Gift Transaction mirror: run skipped, switched off
labels.value: The Gift Transaction mirror run did nothing, because the Gift Transaction mirror is switched off on the Automation page. Switch it on for its runs to work again.

labels.shortDescription: Gift Transaction mirror: run skipped, not ready
labels.value: The Gift Transaction mirror run did nothing. {0}

labels.shortDescription: Gift Transaction mirror: records left for next run
labels.value: The Gift Transaction mirror left some gifts for the next run, because copying them in the same transaction would have gone past Salesforce limits. The next run copies them.

labels.shortDescription: Gift Transaction mirror: run summary
labels.value: Gift Transaction mirror run: {0} Gift Transactions created, {1} updated, {2} already up to date, {3} could not be copied (see the Warnings), {4} left for the next run; {5} designations written, {6} allocations to funds with no Gift Designation ID.

labels.shortDescription: Gift Transaction mirror: designations not writable
labels.value: No designations were written: the person running the mirror cannot create Gift Transaction Designations, or this org's designation objects differ from what this version of BarnCRM expects.

labels.shortDescription: Gift Transaction mirror: compare range too large
labels.value: This range holds more than 10,000 gifts or more than 10,000 Gift Transactions, or more records than one comparison can read. Choose a shorter range.

labels.shortDescription: Gift Transaction mirror: compare needs link access
labels.value: Comparing needs the Gift Transaction Mirror permission set, which lets you read the Gift Transaction ID on a gift.

labels.shortDescription: Gift Transaction mirror: compare needs read access
labels.value: Comparing needs read access to Gift Transactions and to their Name, Donor, Transaction Date, Original Amount and Status. Ask your administrator for it.

labels.shortDescription: Gift Transaction mirror: difference, not copied
labels.value: No Gift Transaction

labels.shortDescription: Gift Transaction mirror: difference, link gone
labels.value: Gift Transaction deleted or not visible to you

labels.shortDescription: Gift Transaction mirror: difference, status
labels.value: Gift Transaction does not have the paid status

labels.shortDescription: Gift Transaction mirror: difference, no gift
labels.value: Paid Gift Transaction with no received gift visible to you

labels.shortDescription: Health Check: Gift Transaction mirror stale, title
labels.value: The Gift Transaction Mirror Has Not Run

labels.shortDescription: Health Check: Gift Transaction mirror stale, detail
labels.value: The Gift Transaction mirror's nightly run is scheduled, but no run has completed since {0}. It runs as the person who scheduled it: if they were deactivated or lost access, every run fails before it starts. Open Gift Transaction Mirror in BarnCRM Settings, then stop the nightly run and schedule it again as someone who can run it. The Error Log says why the runs failed.

labels.shortDescription: Gift Transaction mirror page: title
labels.value: Gift Transaction Mirror

labels.shortDescription: Gift Transaction mirror page: direction is Off
labels.value: The Gift Transaction mirror is off. Choose a direction in BarnCRM Settings, Giving, Gift Transaction mirror direction.

labels.shortDescription: Gift Transaction mirror page: what the direction does
labels.value: Direction: Gifts to Gift Transactions. Received gifts dated on or after {0} get a matching Gift Transaction with status {1}.

labels.shortDescription: Gift Transaction mirror page: needs the permission set
labels.value: The Gift Transaction mirror page needs the Gift Transaction Mirror permission set. Ask your BarnCRM admin for it.

labels.shortDescription: Gift Transaction mirror page: column
labels.value: Gift Transaction

labels.shortDescription: Gift Transaction mirror page: column
labels.value: Original Amount
